records.preparation: Dilute concentrate 1+1 with water; a 500 ml bottle makes 1 litre of ready-to-use working developer.
records.reuseInstructions: For films 1-5 use normal developing time; for films 6-10 increase development time by 15%; for films 11-15 increase by 30%.
records.capacityText: 14-15 films 135-36 or 120 per litre of working solution; 50-60 sheet films 9x12 cm per litre.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Unopened concentrate: Bellini B&W developer guideline 1-2 years after purchase under suitable storage conditions.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Concentrate in a capped bottle with air expelled: Bellini guideline 6-8 weeks.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working solution: Bellini guideline 2 weeks left open or 4 weeks in a capped bottle.

records.preparation: Dilute 1+31. For 300 ml working solution use 9 ml concentrate plus 291 ml water.
records.reuseInstructions: Bellini explicitly marks the 1+31 working solution as One-Shot / Singolo Utilizzo.
records.capacityText: 500 ml concentrate yields approximately 50-60 films 135-36; the package makes about 15-16 litres of working developer at 1+31.
records.sourceTitle: Bellini EURO HC Film Developer Technical Data Sheet

records.shelfLifeUnopened: Bellini B&W developer guideline: unopened concentrate 1-2 years after purchase under suitable storage conditions.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Bellini B&W developer guideline: concentrate in a capped bottle with air expelled 6-8 weeks.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Bellini B&W developer guideline: working solution 2 weeks left open or 4 weeks in a capped bottle.

records.preparation: Mix the complete package to the marked stock-solution volume; for tray use dilute 1 part stock developer with 2 parts water (1+2). Kodak does not recommend dividing powdered packages for partial mixing.
records.reuseInstructions: Use the tray working solution during the working day and discard when its useful capacity or one-working-day keeping limit is reached.
records.capacityText: Useful tray capacity: about 32 sheets 8x10 inch per litre of working solution (120 sheets per US gallon).
records.shelfLifeStock: Prepared stock solution in a full closed container: approximately 6 months.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working solution in tray: 1 working day.
records.sourceTitle: KODAK PROFESSIONAL Chemicals for Black-and-White Papers, Publication E103CP

records.manufacturer: Hans O. Mahn GmbH & Co. KG / MACO PHOTO PRODUCTS
records.preparation: For paper use 1+7; example 1 litre working solution uses 125 ml concentrate plus 825 ml water. For film use 1+12; example 260 ml working solution uses 20 ml concentrate plus 240 ml water.
records.capacityText: Paper: up to 100 sheets 8x10 inch per litre of working solution. The current manufacturer page does not publish a film-capacity figure.
records.sourceTitle: MACO ecoprint universal developer manufacturer product information

records.physicalState: two-part liquid concentrate (Part A + Part B)
records.preparation: Two liquid components A and B are combined according to the product development instructions; Bellini identifies the retail kit as a 100 ml A+B pyrocatechin-based developer system.
records.sourceTitle: Bellini / Chimifoto Ornano NUCLEOL BF200 product information
